_note: v2 hook overrides for la Passerelle des Liens (ST_liens, S16_park). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks a reflexive verb; périr and mutiler are shown only as blank museum plaques.

fr_cramponner_verb.hook: In the lakeside wind Monsieur Verbe, spiky CRAMPONS on his boots, CLINGS to the lamp post with arms and legs, his hand mirror in his other hand (krahn-poh-NAY).
fr_cramponner_verb.why: Crampons → se cramponner (à) = to cling (to). The hand mirror shows it is reflexive: il SE cramponne à la rampe. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_joindre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe taps his magic WAND and the two halves of the broken teacup JOIN back together in a burst of sparkles (ZHWANDR).
fr_joindre_verb.why: Wand → joindre = to join; also to reach someone (by phone). GOLD beret = irregular (je joins, nous joignons).

fr_brancher_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe PLUGS the cable INTO a socket on the tree under its BRANCHES, and the tree's lantern lights up (brahn-SHAY).
fr_brancher_verb.why: Branch → brancher = to plug in. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_relier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lays a plank to LINK the stepping stones across the pond; the duck RELIES on it to get across (ruh-LYAY).
fr_relier_verb.why: Rely → relier = to link (un pont relie les deux villages). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_connecter_verb.hook: At a café table Monsieur Verbe CONNECTS to a video call and waves at the smiling face on his laptop screen (koh-nehk-TAY).
fr_connecter_verb.why: Connect → connecter = to connect; the example's se connecter = to log in. The card teaches plain connecter, so no mirror is painted. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_convier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the butler bows and CONVEYS gold-edged INVITATIONS on a silver tray: you are all INVITED (kohn-VYAY).
fr_convier_verb.why: Convey → convier = to invite (nous sommes conviés). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_boiser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe waters the saplings he is planting on a bare mound, a friendly BOA coiled round each one: he is foresting the hill (bwah-ZAY).
fr_boiser_verb.why: Boa → boiser = to afforest, plant trees; also to panel in wood, like the paneled cabins of the alley. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_profiler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe points at his own PROFILE: a black paper silhouette standing on the easel (proh-fee-LAY).
fr_profiler_verb.why: Profile → profiler = to profile, outline; the example's se profiler = to be outlined against the horizon. The card teaches plain profiler, so no mirror is painted. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_centraliser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sets the friendly spider right in the CENTER of its rope web, where every thread meets (sahn-trah-lee-ZAY).
fr_centraliser_verb.why: Central → centraliser = to centralize, gather everything in the middle. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_generaliser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe opens box after box and finds a bone in EVERY one, so the dog GENERALIZES: all boxes hold bones! (zhay-nay-rah-lee-ZAY)
fr_generaliser_verb.why: General → généraliser = to generalize (il ne faut pas généraliser). Used plainly here, so no mirror. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_raccorder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe JOINS the two copper pipes end to end and ties the joint with a long CORD (rah-kor-DAY).
fr_raccorder_verb.why: A CORD → raccorder = to join, connect (pipes, wires). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_articuler_verb.hook: An ARTY parrot in a little beret sits on Monsieur Verbe's finger while he ARTICULATES every word with a big round O (ahr-tee-kew-LAY).
fr_articuler_verb.why: Articulate → articuler = to articulate, speak clearly. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_collaborer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe and a beaver in a red COLLAR COLLABORATE, carrying one long log between them (koh-lah-boh-RAY).
fr_collaborer_verb.why: Collar / collaborate → collaborer = to collaborate. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_cohabiter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe, a COW and a BEE COHABIT in one striped beach hut: he waves from the door, the cow looks out of the window and the bee buzzes on the roof (koh-ah-bee-TAY).
fr_cohabiter_verb.why: COW + BEE + habit → cohabiter = to live together. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_subvenir_verb.hook: At his SOUVENIR stall Monsieur Verbe PROVIDES FOR the duck family, handing bread to the mother duck for her ducklings (sewb-vuh-NEER).
fr_subvenir_verb.why: Souvenir → subvenir (à) = to provide for. GOLD beret = irregular (like venir: il subvient).

fr_eprendre_verb.hook: With a PRAWN on his shoulder, Monsieur Verbe checks his hand mirror and falls head over heels: little hearts float up, he is ENAMORED (ay-PRAHNDR).
fr_eprendre_verb.why: A PRAWN → s'éprendre (de) = to fall for, become enamored with. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive: il S'EST épris. GOLD beret = irregular (like prendre).
